items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I heard regularly McKinney's Cotton Pickers Band every Monday night at the Greystone, and Fletcher Henderson's band came through with Coleman Hawkins and people like that in there -- and Tommy Ladnier, Kaiser Marshall.

ctx.x: Detroit, my mother used to visit her during our summer vacations in Tuskegee, and take me and my brother there -- and when we'd go to Detroit, I got a chance to hear jazz music, you know, on the high level of the big traveling bands, they would come through.

I remember Jimmy Noone band came over once from Chicago and played at the Greystone Ballroom. I heard regularly McKinney's Cotton Pickers Band every Monday night at the Greystone, and Fletcher Henderson's band came through with Coleman Hawkins and people like that in there -- and Tommy Ladnier, Kaiser Marshall.
Oh, Kaiser -- Kaiser's a Texan, too, you know.
